root_cause.text: The vulnerability exists because the `amdgpu_device_set_cg_state` and `amdgpu_device_set_pg_state` functions in the AMDGPU driver assume the `version` pointer in IP blocks is always valid during device teardown, failing to perform a NULL check before dereferencing it when GPU initialization has partially failed.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states that "IP blocks may have a NULL version pointer" when initialization fails and that the cleanup code accesses `adev->ip_blocks[i].version` without NULL checks; the patch diff confirms the fix by adding `if (!adev->ip_blocks[i].version) continue;` guards in both functions immediately before accessing `adev->ip_blocks[i].version->type`.
